college.name: Western Mega College
college.description: Western Mega College stands at the forefront of higher education, offering industry-relevant programs like Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM), Master of Business Administration (MBA), and the upcoming Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT). The institution is dedicated to shaping future hospitality leaders, business professionals, and technology experts through innovative teaching, real-world exposure, and a focus on holistic growth.
college.campus_location_description: Located at the heart of Dhawaha, Butwal

hero_section.subheadline: Join a decade-strong legacy in hospitality, management, and technology education. Our programs blend academic excellence with hands-on experience, preparing you for global careers.

programs.name: Bachelor of Information Technology
programs.description: The Bachelor of Information Technology program prepares students for in-demand IT careers. Learn to design, manage, and support websites, applications, and network systems across industries such as business, healthcare, education, and government. Students can specialize in network security or mobile and web application development, graduating with practical, job-ready skills.
programs.overview: The BIT program at Western Mega College, affiliated with Lincoln University College Malaysia, provides a strong blend of theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience in information technology. Graduates are equipped to solve, support, troubleshoot, and design everything from websites to applications and network systems.

specializations.name: Network Administration & Security
specializations.description: Focus on designing secure networks, ethical hacking, intrusion detection, cryptography, and cyber law.

specializations.name: Mobile & Web Application Development
specializations.description: Focus on building modern web and mobile applications using current frameworks and platforms.

programs.eligibility: Completion of 10+2 or equivalent with minimum 40% aggregate or 2.0 CGPA

message.welcome: Welcome to Western Mega College (WMC)—a place where your dreams meet incredible opportunities.
message.body: As the Principal, I'm truly proud to lead this lively community filled with passionate educators, driven students, and supportive families, all working together towards a common goal of excellence. For more than a decade, Western Mega College has been a shining example of quality education, grounded in holistic development. We believe that real learning goes beyond just textbooks; it's about nurturing critical thinking, encouraging deep understanding, and instilling ethical values that shape character.

pathways.bhm: We are revolutionizing hospitality education with SCHOTEL, our industry-aligned BHM program. This dynamic model ensures you gain the practical expertise needed to thrive in a global hospitality environment.
pathways.mba: Our Master of Business Administration (MBA) program is engineered to equip you with the strategic insights and leadership skills required to succeed in the complex world of modern business.
pathways.bit: Our upcoming Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) program, affiliated with Lincoln University College Malaysia, will prepare students for in-demand technology careers across software development, networking, cybersecurity, and beyond.

message.quote: At Western Mega College, we are committed to delivering practical, career-focused education through our MBA, BHM, and soon BIT programs—shaping future leaders in business, hospitality, and technology.
message.campus_life: Your experience here goes well beyond the classroom. We cultivate a vibrant campus life filled with in-class activities, cultural festivals, CSR activities and leadership opportunities.
message.closing: My door is always open! I warmly invite you to come visit our campus, meet our amazing faculty, and discover for yourself what makes the Western Mega College family so unique.

blogs.title: Established Legacy – Annual Hospitality Festival
blogs.author: Kisan Mahat
blogs.summary: Western Mega College's BHM students successfully organized the Annual Hospitality Festival, a three-day event showcasing exceptional skills and talents in hospitality management.
highlights: Culinary Arts Competition – gourmet dishes judged by professional chefs
Event Management Showcase – live demonstration of event planning
Hotel Operations Simulation – real-time hotel management scenarios

blogs.title: Trek to Kenjing Gumba: Cultural & Educational Expedition
blogs.author: Western Mega College
blogs.summary: 6th-semester BHM students undertook an eight-day trek to Kenjing Gumba in Chitlang, blending cultural exploration, academic enrichment, and physical challenge.
highlights: Days 1-2: Cultural immersion through authentic local homestays
Days 3-4: Educational visits to traditional goat cheese production facilities
Days 5-6: Learning about wine processing from local artisan producers
Days 7-8: Spiritual exploration at historic Kenjing Gumba monastery

blogs.title: Industrial Visit – CG Unnati Cultural Village, Chitwan
blogs.author: Western Mega College
blogs.summary: 2nd-semester BHM students visited Unnati Cultural Village in Harkapur, Chitwan for an in-depth experience in cultural heritage preservation and community-driven tourism.
highlights: Art & craft workshops: pottery, weaving, natural dye making, wood carving

blogs.author: Western Mega College

faqs.question: What programs does Western Mega College offer?
faqs.answer: Western Mega College currently offers Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM) and Master of Business Administration (MBA), both affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia. The Bachelor of Information Technology (BIT) program is coming soon with expected intake in 2026.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the BHM program?
faqs.answer: The BHM program is a 4-year program divided into 8 semesters.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the MBA program?
faqs.answer: The MBA program is a 2-year program divided into 4 semesters.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the BIT program?
faqs.answer: The upcoming BIT program will be a 3-year program divided into 6 semesters, affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for BHM?
faqs.answer: Applicants must have completed 10+2 or equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 40%.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for MBA?
faqs.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50%.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for BIT?
faqs.answer: Applicants must have completed 10+2 or equivalent with a minimum of 40% aggregate or 2.0 CGPA.

faqs.question: How can I apply for admission?
faqs.answer: You can apply online through our website's Admission page, or visit the college campus. Contact us at 9857071252 or info@westernmegacollege.edu.np for guidance.

faqs.question: Does WMC provide placement support?
faqs.answer: Yes. WMC has strong industry connections with leading hospitality and business organizations both in Nepal and internationally, providing internship placements and job placement support.

faqs.question: Is Western Mega College affiliated with a foreign university?
faqs.answer: Yes. WMC is affiliated with Lincoln University College, Malaysia — a globally recognized institution. Degrees carry the credential of Lincoln University College.

faqs.question: Where is Western Mega College located?
faqs.answer: WMC is located in Dhawaha, Butwal, Lumbini Province, Nepal — within the Aramba Resort complex. Contact: 071422131/132/134.

faqs.question: What specializations are available in the BIT program?
faqs.answer: The BIT program offers two specializations: Network Administration & Security (covering ethical hacking, cryptography, cyber law) and Mobile & Web Application Development.
